content:
You are helping me build MaaSetu ("Her care travels with her"), a student
prototype for a maternal health challenge in India.

PROBLEM
About 1 in 3 women in India go to their natal (parents') home around
childbirth. Her original ASHA/ANM loses track of her, and the receiving
village's ASHA often doesn't know she has arrived. MaaSetu is a consent-based
handover app between the two health workers, plus a simple progress view for
the mother.

SAFETY RULES (non-negotiable)
- Assistive only. The app stores, shares (with consent), notifies and reminds.
- It NEVER diagnoses, scores risk, recommends treatment, or flags any value as
  normal/abnormal.
- All care-plan and warning-sign text is pre-written and clinician-approved.
  Do not generate medical content.
- Synthetic data only. No real patient data, ever.

TECH STACK
- React + Vite, as an installable PWA (vite-plugin-pwa)
- Tailwind CSS
- Firebase (Auth with phone OTP, Firestore, Cloud Functions, FCM)
- Start with the Firebase Local Emulator Suite so I can develop without a
  live project.
- i18n from day one (react-i18next) with English, Hindi and Marathi files.
  All UI text goes in translation files, never hard-coded.

TASK FOR THIS STEP ONLY
1. Scaffold the project with a clean folder structure
   (pages, components, services, i18n, data).
2. Set up routing and three role-based areas: ASHA, ANM, Mother. Use a simple
   role switcher for now, with real auth to come later.
3. Define the Firestore data model and write it as TypeScript types:
   - users (id, name, role, village, phone)
   - mothers (id, name, village, registeredBy, language, consentStatus)
   - journeyCards (motherId, milestones: [{name, dueDate, status, doneDate}],
     visits: [{date, enteredBy, note}])
   - handovers (motherId, fromVillage, toVillage, fromWorkerId,
     toWorkerId, status: pending|accepted|completed, createdAt)
   - consentLog (motherId, type, grantedAt, grantedBy, withdrawnAt)
   Include an audit trail on every write (who, when).
4. Create a seed script with 3 fake mothers, 2 villages, and 4 health workers.
   Mark every record as synthetic.
5. Build only a placeholder home screen for each role showing the role name
   and a language switcher (EN/HI/MR).
6. Make it mobile-first (360px width) with large, readable text, since users
   will have low-end Android phones.

DO NOT build handover, QR, notifications or offline mode yet.

OUTPUT
- Show the folder structure first, then the code.
- Explain how to run it locally in 5 lines or fewer.
- List any assumptions you made.

 */
import {
  COLLECTIONS,
  SYNTHETIC_FLAG,
  type ActorRole,
  type AuditLogEntry,
  type AuditStamp,
  type Role,
} from '../data/model';

export interface Actor {
  id: string;
  role: ActorRole;
}

/** Used by the seed script only — never for real user writes. */
export const SEED_ACTOR: Actor = { id: 'system:seed', role: 'system' };

export function nowIso(): string {
  return new Date().toISOString();
}

/** Fresh stamp for a brand-new document. */
export function newAudit(actor: Actor, at: string = nowIso()): AuditStamp {
  return {
    createdBy: actor.id,
    createdByRole: actor.role,
    createdAt: at,
    updatedBy: actor.id,
    updatedByRole: actor.role,
    updatedAt: at,
  };
}

/** Keep the original creation stamp, move the update stamp forward. */
export function touchAudit(previous: AuditStamp, actor: Actor, at: string = nowIso()): AuditStamp {
  return {
    ...previous,
     [… 78 characters omitted] 
}

/** Minimal write surface shared by the client and admin Firestore SDKs. */
export interface AuditStore {
  write(collection: string, id: string, data: Record<string, unknown>, merge?: boolean): Promise<void>;
}

let auditSeq = 0;

function auditLogId(at: string, collection: string, docId: string): string {
  auditSeq += 1;
  return `${at}_${collection}_${docId}_${auditSeq}`.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '-');
}

function auditEntry(
  collection: string,
  docId: string,
  action: 'create' | 'update',
  stamp: { by: string; byRole: ActorRole; at: string },
  changes?: string[],
): AuditLogEntry {
  const entry: AuditLogEntry = {
    id: auditLogId(stamp.at, collection, docId),
    collection,
    docId,
    action,
    by: stamp.by,
    byRole: stamp.byRole,
    at: stamp.at,
    synthetic: SYNTHETIC_FLAG,
  };
  if (changes && changes.length > 0) entry.changes = changes;
  return entry;
}

/** Create a document: write it with an `audit` stamp, then log the write. */
export async function createDoc<T extends { id: string; audit: AuditStamp; synthetic: typeof SYNTHETIC_FLAG }>(
  store: AuditStore,
  collection: string,
  doc: T,
): Promise<void> {
  await store.write(collection, doc.id, doc as unknown as Record<string, unknown>);
  const entry = auditEntry(collection, doc.id, 'create', {
    by: doc.audit.createdBy,
    byRole: doc.audit.createdByRole,
    at: doc.audit.createdAt,
  });
  await store.write(COLLECTIONS.auditLog, entry.id, entry as unknown as Record<string, unknown>);
}

/** Patch a document: keep the creation stamp, refresh the update stamp, log it. */
export async function updateDoc<T extends { id: string; audit: AuditStamp; synthetic: typeof SYNTHETIC_FLAG }>(
  store: AuditStore,
  collection: string,
  doc: T,
  patch: Partial<T>,
  actor: Actor,
  at: string = nowIso(),
): Promise<void> {
  const previous = doc.audit;
  const merged: T = { ...doc, ...patch, audit: touchAudit(previous, actor, at) };
  await store.write(collection, merged.id, merged as unknown as Record<string, unknown>, true);
  const entry = auditEntry(
    collection,
    merged.id,
    'update',
    { by: actor.id, byRole: actor.role as Role, at },
    Object.keys(patch),
  );
  await store.write(COLLECTIONS.auditLog, entry.id, entry as unknown as Record<string, unknown>);
}

});

  createContext,
  useContext,
  useEffect,
  useMemo,
  useState,
  type ReactNode,
} from 'react';
import type { Role } from '../data/model';

/** All three role areas, in display order. */
export const ROLES: Role[] = ['asha', 'anm', 'mother'];

/** Route for each role area. */
export const ROLE_PATH: Record<Role, string> = {
  asha: '/asha',
  anm: '/anm',
  mother: '/mother',
};

const STORAGE_KEY = 'maasetu.role';

interface RoleContextValue {
  role: Role;
  setRole: (role: Role) => void;
}

const RoleContext = createContext<RoleContextValue | null>(null);

/**
 * Temporary role switcher (step 1): picks which role area to open and
 * remembers it on this device. Real phone-OTP auth replaces it later.
 */
export function RoleProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [role, setRole] = useState<Role>(() => {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    return ROLES.includes(saved as Role) ? (saved as Role) : 'asha';
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, role);
  }, [role]);

  const value = useMemo(() => ({ role, setRole }), [role]);

  return <RoleContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</RoleContext.Provider>;
}

export function useRole(): RoleContextValue {
  const ctx = useContext(RoleContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error('useRole must be used inside <RoleProvider>');
  return ctx;
}

**Data model — [src/data/model.ts](src/data/model.ts)** (the core of this step)

```ts
export const SYNTHETIC_FLAG = 'synthetic-prototype-v1' as const;

export type Role = 'asha' | 'anm' | 'mother';
export type Language = 'en' | 'hi' | 'mr';
export type ActorRole = Role | 'system';

/** Who performed a write and when. Present on every document. */
export interface AuditStamp {
  createdBy: string;  createdByRole: ActorRole;  createdAt: string;   // ISO 8601 UTC
  updatedBy: string;  updatedByRole: ActorRole;  updatedAt: string;
}

/** Every stored document carries id + synthetic flag + audit stamp. */
export interface AuditedDoc { id: string; synthetic: typeof SYNTHETIC_FLAG; audit: AuditStamp }

export interface User extends AuditedDoc { name: string; role: Role; village: string; phone: string; language: Language }
export interface Mother extends AuditedDoc { name: string; village: string; registeredBy: string; language: Language; consentStatus: 'pending' | 'granted' | 'withdrawn' }
export interface Village extends AuditedDoc { name: string; block: string; district: string; state: string }

export interface Milestone { name: string; dueDate: string; status: 'pending' | 'done'; doneDate: string | null }
export interface Visit     { date: string; enteredBy: string; note: string }
export interface JourneyCard extends AuditedDoc { motherId: string; milestones: Milestone[]; visits: Visit[] }

export interface Handover extends AuditedDoc {
  motherId: string; fromVillage: string; toVillage: string;
  fromWorkerId: string; toWorkerId: string;
  status: 'pending' | 'accepted' | 'completed'; createdAt: string;
}

export interface ConsentLogEntry extends AuditedDoc {
  motherId: string; type: 'handover' | 'historyShare' | 'reminders';
  grantedAt: string | null; grantedBy: string | null; withdrawnAt: string | null;
}

/** Append-only trail: one entry per write, on every collection. */
export interface AuditLogEntry {
  id: string; collection: string; docId: string; action: 'create' | 'update';
  by: string; byRole: ActorRole; at: string; changes?: string[];
  synthetic: typeof SYNTHETIC_FLAG;
}

export const COLLECTIONS = {
  villages: 'villages', users: 'users', mothers: 'mothers', journeyCards: 'journeyCards',
  handovers: 'handovers', consentLog: 'consentLog', auditLog: 'auditLog',
} as const;
```

**Audit on every write — [src/services/audit.ts](src/services/audit.ts)**

```ts
export interface AuditStore { write(collection: string, id: string, data: Record<string, unknown>, merge?: boolean): Promise<void> }

export function newAudit(actor: Actor, at = nowIso()): AuditStamp   // fresh document
export function touchAudit(previous: AuditStamp, actor: Actor, at = nowIso()): AuditStamp

/** Every write must go through these two: they stamp the doc AND append to auditLog. */
export async function createDoc<T extends AuditedDoc>(store, collection, doc: T): Promise<void>
export async function updateDoc<T extends AuditedDoc>(store, collection, doc, patch, actor, at?): Promise<void>
```

`createDoc` writes the document, then writes `{ collection, docId, action: 'create', by, byRole, at }` into `auditLog`. The seed script and the future app code both call these, so a write that skips the trail is impossible by construction. The helpers are SDK-agnostic: [src/services/firebase.ts](src/services/firebase.ts) supplies a client-SDK `AuditStore`, `scripts/seed.ts` supplies an Admin-SDK one.

## 4. Assumptions

1. **No `villages` collection was specified, but the seed needs villages** — I added one (`id, name, block, district, state`) and reference it by id from `users`, `mothers` and `handovers`.
2. **Every document has an `id` equal to its Firestore doc id** (your spec listed `id` only for `users`/`mothers`), plus two extra fields you asked for indirectly: `synthetic` and `audit`. Handovers keep the explicit `createdAt` you asked for, alongside `audit`.
3. **Timestamps are ISO-8601 UTC strings**, not Firestore `Timestamp`s, so the client SDK, Admin SDK, the seed JSON and the emulator console all read identically. Easy to swap later.
4. **Milestone labels (`ANC visit 1`, `Postnatal visit 1`, …) are placeholders** pending the clinician-approved wording — I did not write care-plan or warning-sign copy, and status is only `pending|done` (no normal/abnormal, no scoring).

PROBLEM
About 1 in 3 women in India go to their natal (parents') home around
childbirth. Her original ASHA/ANM loses track of her, and the receiving
village's ASHA often doesn't know she has arrived. MaaSetu is a consent-based
handover app between the two health workers, plus a simple progress view for
the mother.

SAFETY RULES (non-negotiable)
- Assistive only. The app stores, shares (with consent), notifies and reminds.
- It NEVER diagnoses, scores risk, recommends treatment, or flags any value as

- All care-plan and warning-sign text is pre-written and clinician-approved.
  Do not generate medical content.
- Synthetic data only. No real patient data, ever.

- i18n from day one (react-i18next) with English, Hindi and Marathi files.

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';

interface AsyncState<T> {
  data: T | null;
  loading: boolean;
  error: boolean;
}

/**
 * Small loader hook: runs `loader` whenever `deps` change and exposes
 * loading / error / data plus a manual `reload`. Errors are surfaced as a flag
 * so screens can show a translated message and a retry button.
 */
export function useAsyncData<T>(
  loader: () => Promise<T>,
  deps: unknown[],
): AsyncState<T> & { reload: () => void } {
  const [state, setState] = useState<AsyncState<T>>({ data: null, loading: true, error: false });
  const [nonce, setNonce] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    setState((prev) => ({ data: prev.data, loading: true, error: false }));

    loader()
      .then((data) => {
        if (!cancelled) setState({ data, loading: false, error: false });
      })
      .catch((error: unknown) => {
        console.error('MaaSetu: data load failed', error);
        if (!cancelled) setState({ data: null, loading: false, error: true });
      });

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
    // `loader` is intentionally excluded: deps describe its inputs.
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [...deps, nonce]);

  const reload = useCallback(() => setNonce((n) => n + 1), []);

  return { ...state, reload };
}
